strategy.thesis: India's first sector-specific angel investor network, formed as a public-private partnership between BIRAC (Department of Biotechnology) and Indian Angel Network (IAN) to channel HNI/angel capital, mentoring and market access into early-stage biotech, medtech, healthtech and pharma startups.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Runs as a consortium of angels, HNIs and early-stage VCs curated jointly by BIRAC and IAN; deal flow leans on BIRAC's national biotech-startup pipeline.

people.name: Padmaja Ruparel
people.background: Co-Founder of Indian Angel Network; led the launch of BioAngels together with BIRAC

summary.en: BioAngels is India's first sector-focused angel investor network for biotech, medtech, healthtech and pharma startups, launched in 2019 as a public-private partnership between BIRAC (Department of Biotechnology) and Indian Angel Network.

strategy.thesis: A private angel-investor platform operated by BIORx Venture Advisors that channels HNI/angel capital into early-stage healthcare, med-tech, life-sciences, pharma, biotech and digital-health ventures across India.

summary.en: Indian Healthcare Angels (IHA) is a Noida-based private angel-investment platform run by BIORx Venture Advisors, connecting angel investors with early-stage healthcare, medtech, life-sciences, pharma, biotech and digital-health startups.

strategy.thesis: A Tata Trusts venture-philanthropy initiative operating India's first public-private partnership fund with BIRAC to co-finance development of diagnostics and digital tools that tackle infectious diseases such as tuberculosis, dengue and antimicrobial resistance.

summary.en: India Health Fund is a Tata Trusts venture-philanthropy initiative that, in partnership with BIRAC, co-funds development of diagnostics and digital tools to combat infectious diseases (TB, dengue, antimicrobial resistance) relevant to India, operating as the Confluence for Health Action and Transformation Foundation (CHATF).

sources.title: India Health Fund and BIRAC Partnership
sources.supports: existence, Tata Trusts/BIRAC partnership, pooled fund size, focus areas, legal structure (CHATF)
sources.quote: India's first public-private partnership fund which will finance the development of diagnostics and digital tools to tackle infectious diseases relevant for India and other developing countries...commits INR 44 Crores of pooled funding to be deployed over 5 years

verification_notes: Founding year of India Health Fund itself (it predates the 2023/24 BIRAC co-funding MoU referenced here) was not established from the sources reviewed. Operates legally as CHATF (Confluence for Health Action and Transformation Foundation), a Section 8 charitable company, per the source page.

strategy.thesis: The dedicated family office of entrepreneur Nihar Parikh (former promoter of Zandu Pharmaceuticals / ZCL Chemicals), investing exclusively in venture-stage health-tech companies spanning digital health, pharmacy, diagnostics, surgical care and AI-driven care delivery.

people.name: Nihar Parikh
people.background: Former promoter of ZCL Chemicals (formerly Zandu Chemicals/Pharmaceuticals), sold to Advent International before founding 4Point0

summary.en: 4Point0 Health Ventures is the Mumbai-based family office of entrepreneur Nihar Parikh, set up in 2022 to deploy roughly $75M exclusively into venture-stage health-tech startups spanning digital health, diagnostics, pharmacy and AI-driven care delivery in India.

strategy.thesis: The strategic investment platform of the Burman family (promoters of Dabur Group); healthcare is one of three core verticals (alongside Financial Services and Branded Consumer), with holdings including a joint venture with Japanese digital-health company M3, homecare provider Healthcare at Home, and clinical-reference app DailyRounds.

summary.en: Burman Family Holdings is the family office of the Burman family (Dabur Group promoters), investing across Healthcare, Financial Services and Branded Consumer; its healthcare bets include a joint venture with Japan's M3 (digital health platform for doctors), homecare provider Healthcare at Home, and clinical-reference app DailyRounds.

sources.title: Burman Family Holdings | The strategic investment platform of the Burman Family
sources.supports: sector focus (Healthcare as core vertical), healthcare investments (M3 India, Healthcare at Home, DailyRounds), HQ/office locations
sources.quote: strategic investment platform of the Burman family...focuses on Healthcare, Financial Services, Hospitality, Education, and Media

verification_notes: Healthcare is one of several investment verticals rather than the sole focus; included because a clear, sourced medical/biomedical nexus exists (M3 India JV, Healthcare at Home, DailyRounds). The reported ~US$500M total capital deployed over 20 years spans all verticals (not healthcare alone), so it was not entered as a health-specific capital figure.
